product_metadata.title: Classic Brands Head Up Only Adjustable Bed Base, King
features: Easy to use wired remote for head up and head down positions
Durable and whisper quiet motor; full lift under 30 seconds
12-inch leg height; mattress retention rail included
Base can be used on floor or in a standard bed frame (sold separately).
Adjustable mattress friendly- ideal for use with memory foam, latex, and air mattresses; tool-less assembly; ships directly to your door
Split King base requires 2 Twin XL bases and 2 TXL mattresses (sold separately) which allows each side to be controlled independently
description: Our simple to use remote-controlled head-up adjustable base is a perfect upgrade from just a regular box spring or foundation. Use our adjustable base to raise your mattress and your head in an upright position so you can watch tv, read, utilize your laptop, and more; lower the head for resting and sleeping. Our head-up adjustable base is easy to assemble with no tools needed and can be placed directly on the floor or on a standard bed frame (sold separately).
